solutions.code:
count = total = positive = negative = 0
maximum = 0
while True:
    number = int(input('Введите число: '))
    if number == 0:
        break
    if count == 0 or number > maximum:
        maximum = number
    count += 1
    total += number
    if number > 0:
        positive += 1
    else:
        negative += 1
print('Всего:', count)
print('Сумма:', total)
print('Полож.:', positive)
print('Отриц.:', negative)
print('Макс.:', maximum)
